name: A London billboard, live from the Algarve
what_it_does: A simulated demonstration of Dinis Cruz's weather-driven billboard: a portrait screen in London (weather simulated) or a Portuguese city (live IPMA), showing the Algarve live from the public data PrompTugal.news collects.
team: conductor.london-billboard@AgentiCCells.dinis and its team (analyst, designer, developer, writer, reviewer), instructed by Dinis Cruz
